newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Caracas stocks close mixed in quiet trading.
newsitem.headline: Caracas stocks close mixed in quiet trading.

text.p: Caracas stocks closed mixed in quiet trading with little foreign presence, traders said.
The market's leading 19-share index finished 1.14 point lower, or 0.02 percent, to close at 6,599.61 points, according to the exchange's preliminary figures.
"It was very quiet and stable, mainly local investors," said Harold Cuellar, of Cavelba brokerage.
A total 38.23 million shares were traded, worth 3.95 billion bolivars ($8.30 million). Among traded issues, 26 fell, six rose and nine closed flat.
